title: The operator's Send again on a stuck seller transfer refused every partially refunded order, which the reconciler still pays
detail:
FOUND 2026-10-05 in the scan-six read of LIVE-624 (ced6bf6). A PARTIAL refund stamps `commerce_orders.refunded_at` and leaves the status `paid`, and ADR-1615 / orderIsPayable keep paying its sellers (the refund reverses each share pro rata). retryOrderTransfer refused any order with `refunded_at` set, so on a partially refunded order with a stuck transfer the operator read 'This order was refunded' and could not pay that seller their remaining share; only the reconciler could, and only until MAX_TRANSFER_ATTEMPTS.

CLOSED 2026-10-05: the retry reads the status alone, as orderIsPayable does; a fully refunded order (status `refunded`) is still refused. transfer-retry.test.ts now pins both: the refunded order refused, the partially refunded one retried.

verify.note: Fails on main before this change (mutation-checked).

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-six adversarial read of the 2026-09-28..30 merges
